{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ttfo.8","title":"Python _admissible/process_dio accept below-root parent ranks; joins where rust candidate_admissible refuses","description":"## Location

`python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py` `DodagState.process_dio` (loop check is skipped when `self.rank == INFINITE_RANK`) and `_admissible` (MaxRankIncrease / overflow only). Contrast `rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs` `candidate_admissible`: rejects `candidate.rank < min_hop_rank_increase` and `DAGRank(cost) <= DAGRank(candidate.rank)` (RFC 6550 Section 3.5.1).

## What goes wrong

RFC 6550 Section 8.2.2.4: DODAG Root Rank is MinHopRankIncrease (256). A parent advertising Rank 100 is illegal. Python still installs it:

1. Unjoined (or just `_adopt_version`'d) node has `rank == INFINITE_RANK`, so `dio.rank >= self.rank` is skipped.
2. `_admissible` does not apply a root floor or require a strictly greater DAGRank.
3. `select_parent` joins at `100 + 256 = 356`.

Trigger:

    node = DodagState(rpl_instance_id=0, dodag_id="fd00::1", version=1)
    node.process_dio(DIO(..., rank=100, version=1), P1, link_etx=1.0)
    # JOINED, preferred_parent=P1, rank=356

Newer-version path (dual-impl divergence vs rust): joined at version 1, then DIO version=2 rank=100. Python `_adopt_version` then joins through rank 100. Rust `candidate_admissible` returns false (`rank < mhri`), adopts the version, and returns Rejected without inserting the parent -- node stays UNJOINED at version 2.

Same-version unjoined path also exists in rust `select_parent` (`admissible()` vs `candidate_admissible()`); that is project-LICHEN-worker6-2rqi. Python has no `candidate_admissible` at all, so both the first-join and version-adopt paths accept the spoof.

An attacker advertising Rank 1 wins parent selection against a legitimate root-neighbor (cost 257 vs 512; hysteresis threshold 192). Related: `link_etx=0` yields `path_cost == parent.rank` (RFC 8.2.2.4 Rank MUST increase); rust `process_dio` rejects `link_etx < 1.0`. Distinct from already-open xtzn (mhri=0) and dfv6/lwo3 (NaN/inf).

## Fix

Port rust `candidate_admissible` into Python `_admissible` / `process_dio`: refuse rank < MinHopRankIncrease, refuse DAGRank(cost) <= DAGRank(parent rank), and fail closed on `link_etx < 1.0` (or at least on a zero rank increment). Add a process_dio test with parent rank 100 and independently computed expected rejection (not `node._admissible(...)` as oracle).
